entities.summary: Kiyoshi Ishikawa, known by his pen name Jun Ishikawa, was a Japanese modernist author, translator and literary critic active during the Shōwa era. Jun Ishikawa was a authors & novelists from Asakusa-ku (1899-03-07, Asakusa-ku–1987-12-29). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Its legacy: Created literary works of enduring influence.
